story.default_objective: Follow the dirt roads to recover the lost campfires, then confront the mirror at the eastern gate.
story.region.meadow_wake.name: Meadow Wake
story.region.meadow_wake.objective: The first campfire is alive. Follow the eastern road and find what broke the village.
story.region.silent_market.name: Silent Market
story.region.silent_market.objective: The market is empty, but the road still points east. Push through the ruins.
story.region.western_watch.name: Western Watch
story.region.western_watch.objective: A side path leads to an old watch post. Claim the campfire before returning to the main road.
story.region.pilgrim_crossing.name: Pilgrim Crossing
story.region.pilgrim_crossing.objective: The road splits around an enemy patrol. Win the crossing and the mirror gate will come into view.
story.region.glass_shrine.name: Glass Shrine
story.region.glass_shrine.objective: The shrine campfire offers one last recovery. Gather strength before the eastern road.
story.region.mirror_gate.name: Mirror Gate
story.region.mirror_gate.objective: The clone waits beyond the gate. Defeat it to prove Verso is more than an echo.
